facts.fact: IT-Online reports that BankservAfrica opened the first instant low-value digital payment corridor between South Africa and Zambia on 1 March 2024, after SendHome and SamPay joined the TCIB scheme.
IT-Online reports that the SADC TCIB scheme, live since 2021 and operated by BankservAfrica, now carries the South Africa-Zambia corridor, with SendHome and SamPay as its newest participants.
